title: Fast and Efficient Bayesian Analysis of Structural Vector Autoregressions Using the R Package bsvars
abstract: arXiv:2410.15090v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The R package bsvars provides a wide range of tools for empirical macroeconomic and financial analyses using Bayesian Structural Vector Autoregressions. It uses frontier econometric techniques and C++ code to ensure fast and efficient estimation of these multivariate dynamic structural models, possibly with many variables, complex identification strategies, and non-linear characteristics. The models can be identified using adjustable exclusion restrictions and heteroskedastic or non-normal shocks. They feature a flexible three-level equation-specific local-global hierarchical prior distribution for the estimated level of shrinkage for autoregressive and structural parameters. translated_title: 使用R包bsvars进行结构向量自回归的快速高效贝叶斯分析
translated_abstract: R包bsvars为使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归进行实证宏观和金融分析提供了广泛的工具。它采用前沿计量经济学技术和C++代码，确保这些多元动态结构模型的快速高效估计，可能涉及许多变量、复杂的识别策略和非线性特征。这些模型可以使用可调节的排除限制以及异方差或非正态冲击进行识别。它们具有灵活的三层方程特定局部-全局分层先验分布，用于估计自回归和结构参数的收缩水平。此外，该包还通过脉冲响应、预测误差方差和历史分解、预测、识别和自回归参数假设的统计验证以及分析来促进预测和结构分析。
tldr: 本文介绍了R包bsvars，它通过C++实现和灵活的分层先验分布，实现了快速高效的贝叶斯结构向量自回归估计，并支持广泛的宏观和金融实证分析功能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the R package bsvars, which enables fast and efficient Bayesian estimation of structural vector autoregressions through C++ implementation and flexible hierarchical priors, supporting a wide range of empirical macroeconomic and financial analyses.
